task.description:
Read docs/requirements/BPM_Architecture_Backlog.20260611.md (ISS-601, ISS-602), src/engine/instance.zig, src/expr/*, vendor/cel, templates/lego-catalog.md. Write TWO Type E design docs (no implementation code):

1. src/design/iss601_state_snapshots.md: Periodic per-instance state snapshots. Reconstruction folds events since latest snapshot instead of full replay. Must join event_payloads_overflow. NFR-04 benchmark: <=5s for 10k events. Snapshot table schema: instance_id, snapshot_seq, state_blob (JSONB), created_at. Snapshot interval: every 1000 events or on instance completion.

2. src/design/iss602_cel_expr_differential.md: CEL->expr differential test corpus. Harness loads a corpus of gateway conditions (from real stored definitions). Evaluates each on BOTH vendor/cel AND src/expr/. Asserts identical boolean results. Divergences catalogued with condition text + expected/actual. Blocks cutover: no production code imports src/expr/ until corpus is green. ISS-201 provides TransitionResult with events.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/iss601_state_snapshots.md exists with Type E prose design (no implementation code)
src/design/iss602_cel_expr_differential.md exists with Type E prose design (no implementation code)
Both designs cover all acceptance criteria from ISS-601 and ISS-602
Error taxonomy and public function signatures listed for both
No implementation code (Zig, SQL) in either design doc

result.summary: Produced two Type E prose design documents: ISS-601 State Snapshots for large-instance reconstruction, and ISS-602 CEL-to-expr differential test corpus harness. Both designs cover all acceptance criteria, list public function signatures, define error taxonomies, and document dependencies. No implementation code (Zig or SQL) present.
